guards: every AUDIT_DB_TEST_URL-gated test suite is named by a runner (db-test-container.mjs's *_SUITE_FILES) or carries a written exemption

poisonPill.why: An ordinary-looking integration suite gated on AUDIT_DB_TEST_URL, added without being enrolled anywhere. This is the SILENT variant and the only one that matters: the suite compiles, the runner reports it as a clean pass, and `npm run check` goes green over coverage that never executed. Fifteen suites sat in this exact state — one, tests/plans-ship-persona-correlation.test.mjs, shipped with the WS1 correlator and failed on its first-ever run once enrolled, on a schema CHECK that had rejected its fixture since 20260413224948. The pill is an overlay rather than a mutation of the registry because ADDING an unenrolled file is how this happens in practice; deleting an entry from a *_SUITE_FILES list would test the same predicate from the side that a reviewer can already see in a diff.
